mapper.select: SELECT M.MEMBER_NO, N.MEMBER_ID, M.MEMBER_NAME, M.ROLE, M.SOCIAL_PROVIDER, M.IMG_PATH, M.SAVE_NAME, M.ENROLL_DATE FROM WELLNESS_MEMBER M LEFT JOIN WELLNESS_NORMAL_MEMBER N ON N.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO WHERE M.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND M.DEL_YN = 'N'
SELECT MEMBER_NO, IMG_PATH, SAVE_NAME FROM WELLNESS_MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND DEL_YN = 'N' FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE WELLNESS_MEMBER SET MEMBER_NAME = #{memberName} WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT N.MEMBER_PWD FROM WELLNESS_NORMAL_MEMBER N JOIN WELLNESS_MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = N.MEMBER_NO WHERE N.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND M.DEL_YN = 'N' AND M.SOCIAL_PROVIDER = 'BASIC'
mapper.update: UPDATE WELLNESS_MEMBER SET ORIGINAL_NAME = #{originalName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SAVE_NAME = #{saveName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, IMG_PATH = #{imgPath,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
